findings.description: The audit trail bucket, whose purpose is tamper-evident audit records, is created with acl = "log-delivery-write", which grants the S3 log delivery group WRITE and READ_ACP on the bucket. This is a broad predefined ACL on a security-critical bucket and allows audit evidence to be modified or removed.
